executive_summary: Child F of orchestrator SD-LEO-INFRA-AUDIT-FIX-FEEDBACK-001 fixes 6 feedback-table .update() call sites in the SD/QF completion tail and coordinator/chairman resolution flows, all broken by the live append-only trigger on public.feedback (database/chairman-gated/20260907_feedback_immutability_trigger.sql). PLAN-phase re-verification of the highest-priority site (lib/learning/outcome-tracker.js) corrected the parent orchestrator's risk framing: both of its update() calls (lines 176-183 bulk-resolve, 191-197 backfill) throw on error, but BOTH of its two callers (scripts/modules/handoff/executors/lead-final-approval/index.js:868-878 and scripts/modules/complete-quick-fix/orchestrator.js:1172-1178) already wrap the call in try/catch and log a warning rather than aborting the completion. This is a silent DATA-QUALITY gap (feedback rows never get status='resolved'/resolution_sd_id recorded on every SD/QF completion), not a completion-blocking crash as the parent's initial audit implied -- still high-value to fix given its every-completion reach, but not an emergency.

functional_requirements.title: Fix lib/learning/outcome-tracker.js's two feedback.update() call sites
functional_requirements.description: Lines 176-183 (bulk status='resolved'+resolved_at+resolution_sd_id transition) and 191-197 (resolution_sd_id backfill), both keyed on .in('id', ids), currently throw on the append-only trigger rejection. Replace with an insert-based correction: for each affected feedback row, insert a NEW feedback row (or a dedicated small linkage table if a bulk multi-row correction doesn't fit the single-row insert-with-pointer shape cleanly) recording the resolution outcome, rather than mutating the original row. Confirmed callers already fail-soft (try/catch + warn), so this fix restores DATA CAPTURE, it does not unblock a currently-blocked completion path.
acceptance_criteria: A real or faithfully simulated SD/QF completion through both callers records the outcome data with 0 'Outcome loop closure failed' / 'Outcome-tracker record skipped' warnings in the logs

functional_requirements.title: Fix scripts/modules/handoff/executors/lead-final-approval/index.js's feedback.update() call site
functional_requirements.description: L1579-1588 batch-sets status='resolved'+resolved_at/resolution_notes via .in('id', ...) in the core LEAD-FINAL-APPROVAL executor. Convert to the insert-with-supersedes-pointer pattern (QF-20260911-515 precedent).
acceptance_criteria: A real LEAD-FINAL-APPROVAL run resolves its linked feedback rows via the new pattern with 0 append-only trigger errors

acceptance_criteria: A retro-generation run acknowledges its linked feedback rows via the new pattern with 0 append-only trigger errors

functional_requirements.title: Fix lib/coordinator/pending-question-timer.cjs and lib/chairman/classifier-denial-guard.mjs feedback.update() call sites
functional_requirements.description: pending-question-timer.cjs L258-267 sets status='resolved'+resolved_at+resolution_notes+metadata (guarded on eq(status,'new'), flag-gated coordinator tick); classifier-denial-guard.mjs L190-194 sets status='resolved'+resolution_notes+resolved_at on matched completion_flag_finding rows (post-approval hook via chairman-decisions.mjs). Convert both to the insert-with-pointer pattern.
